description: Call this after executing an ATL decision to report the real result: success, failure, timeout, payment or auth failure, unusable result, or any other real execution outcome. Reporting what actually happened is how future routing decisions can improve.

attempt_outcomes.description: Observed results for individual provider execution attempts.

cancelled.description: Whether execution was cancelled before completion.

correlation_id.description: Caller correlation ID linking this result to related work.

decision_reference.description: ATL decision ID returned by the prior atl_decide call.

error_code.description: Provider error code observed during execution.

failure_type.description: Category of the observed execution failure.

final_provider_id.description: Provider that actually completed execution, if it changed.

http_status.description: HTTP status returned by the provider, when applicable.

observed_latency_ms.description: Observed provider execution latency in milliseconds.

outcome_correlation_token.description: ATL token returned with the prior decision to authorize this outcome link.

outcome_status.description: Final real-world execution result, such as SUCCESS or FAILURE.

provider_id.description: Provider selected by ATL for the prior decision.

request_id.description: Caller request ID associated with the prior ATL decision.

session_id.description: MCP session ID returned by initialize.

name: atl_outcome
